chapter: Family, Margaret's story and Eutris's memories
title: Jimmy Harrison's trombone playing
summary: He met trombonist Jimmy Harrison in 1928, loved his comedy and music, and describes his slurred, low-technique style.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: You mentioned before that you were working with Jimmy Harrison, the piano player, in Buffalo?
You played with his band up in Buffalo. When did you first meet Jimmy Harrison, the trombone player?
You met him in 1928. You were working together in Louis Russell's band?
No, no, I never played with him.
You never played with Jimmy Harrison - What did you think of his playing?
Comedy, and music too. I don't know how to explain it.
I sure don't. 'Cause if he played something, when he'd get through he'd make a joke out of what he was playing.
Did he have a lot of technique?
Oh, he didn't have very much?
